description: This file implements cryptography-related classes and functions, including interfaces for cryptographic operations, vault management, and cryptography link handling within the Thunder namespace. It defines classes for cryptography link management, Diffie-Hellman, cipher, random, hash, vault, and cryptography implementations, along with their interface mappings and factory methods.

classes.name: CryptographyLink
classes.description: Manages the cryptography link interface, handles connection to cryptography services, and provides access to cryptography interfaces and device objects.

classes.name: RPCDiffieHellmanImpl
classes.description: RPC wrapper for IDiffieHellman interface, providing thread-safe method calls.

classes.name: RPCCipherImpl
classes.description: RPC wrapper for ICipher interface, providing thread-safe encryption and decryption.

classes.name: RPCRandomImpl
classes.description: RPC wrapper for IRandom interface, providing thread-safe random number generation.

classes.name: RPCHashImpl
classes.description: RPC wrapper for IHash interface, providing thread-safe hash operations.

classes.name: RPCVaultImpl
classes.description: RPC wrapper for IVault interface, managing vault data and cryptographic operations with thread safety.

classes.name: RPCCryptographyImpl
classes.description: RPC wrapper for ICryptography interface, providing access to cryptographic primitives and vaults with thread safety.

classes.name: RandomImpl
classes.description: Implementation of IRandom, providing hardware or software-based random number generation.

classes.name: HashImpl
classes.description: Implementation of IHash, wrapping hash creation and destruction functions.

classes.name: VaultImpl
classes.description: Implementation of IVault and IPersistent, managing vault data, cryptographic keys, and related operations.

classes.name: CryptographyImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ICryptography, providing access to random, hash, and vault services.

methods.name: Cryptography
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an ICryptography interface for a given connection point.

methods.name: VaultId
methods.description: Maps string labels to specific cryptography vault IDs.
